expectations.text: Does not use the native browser confirm()/alert() for the confirmation step
expectations.evidence: New ConfirmDialog.tsx is a fully custom modal (role="alertdialog", nova-card, escape/backdrop close); no confirm()/alert() calls anywhere in the diff.

expectations.text: Confirmation modal/dialog uses shadow-based elevation (.nova-card or equivalent shadow) rather than a plain bordered box
expectations.evidence: ConfirmDialog.tsx line 69: className="nova-card nova-fade-in relative w-full max-w-sm rounded-2xl p-6".

expectations.text: Action buttons reuse existing shared primitives (PrimaryButton/GhostButton) instead of raw unstyled <button>
expectations.evidence: Modal's Cancel/Confirm actions use GhostButton and a new DangerButton/PrimaryButton (ConfirmDialog.tsx lines 88-93). The per-row trash trigger is a raw <button>, but it's a deliberately unlabeled icon control, not a text CTA, and is fully styled with hover/focus-visible states and a 40x40px target (ProjectCard.tsx line 88-95) -- a reasonable exception, not an unstyled element.

expectations.text: The destructive confirm action has a visible pending/loading state while the delete request is in flight
expectations.evidence: ConfirmDialog.tsx line 92: confirm button label swaps to "Deleting…" and both buttons are disabled while loading.

expectations.text: No new hardcoded hex color values are introduced outside src/lib/design-tokens.ts or globals.css
expectations.evidence: Only new hex in globals.css is #b45309, a darker shade paired with --coral for the new danger-button gradient, following the exact same pattern already used for the primary button gradient (--violet, #0f766e).
